item: row 367: the Governments and Law tabs follow a language switch
summary: Ten app-gov-law.js renderers (and one country's loading and failure lines) held through ooLive/ooLiveHtml: the loading and failure lines of Countries, Compare, Aggregates, Groups and the map; the map's Latest available year, redrawn with the picked year still selected; the Law pointer and its hover; and the busy words of Load standard country data (progress kept as numbers), Summarize this change and Add & track (robots words drawn at each draw), each button released to its own label when the work ends. Consent order unchanged and Load standard country data now fails closed without the consent popup; a new map indicator forgets the previous map so a switch cannot draw it back; the Summarize failure toast no longer shows escape codes. Driven as real code, 24 mutations all caught.
